friendly_name: Application-edge read path on the Pack model
purpose_context: Until now the service only proved a persistence-through-domain round-trip; the application and API layers were placeholders on first-pass scaffolding. This mission builds the first real read path end-to-end on the single canonical Pack aggregate, reclassifies the application layer as an outer edge adapter that hosts the service concretizations, gives each layer its own composition configuration aggregated by a deployable entrypoint so modular wired tests are cheap, and removes the first-pass scaffolding outright so there is exactly one model.
purpose_tldr: The charter service's first real functional read path, built on the one canonical Pack model with the application layer as an outer edge.
